Seamless tileable square texture, strictly orthographic top-down view, flat even lighting with no directional shadows, no perspective, no horizon, no objects bigger than a hand, no borders, no frame, no text. Subject: a birch forest floor seen from above, mossy dark-green and olive ground covered with scattered fallen golden-yellow and orange birch leaves and a few twigs, uniform over the whole tile.
